title: A Codex session's read-only PowerShell command in a worktree whose full gate is carried voids the gate's credit; only Claude's Bash lines get the read-only exception
outcome: A Codex (or other non-Claude) session can read source in a worktree while its own full gate is carried there, through a form the host can prove reads only, without voiding the gate's credit. Until then, the rule and the supported route are stated where Codex agents read them.
acceptance: A Codex session's read-only PowerShell command in a worktree whose full gate is carried voids the gate's credit; only Claude's Bash lines get the read-only exception is done
